name: DataTable
label: Data Table
description: The data table to which the row will be inserted.

name: RowValues
label: Row Values
description: An array of values to insert into the row.

name: InsertLocation
label: Insert Location
description: Specifies where to insert the new row.

selectOptions.label: Before Row Index
selectOptions.description: Inserts the row before the specified index.

selectOptions.label: End of Data Table
selectOptions.description: Appends the row at the end of the data table.

name: RowIndex
label: Row Index
description: The zero-based index before which to insert the row (required if 'Insert Location' is 'Before Row Index').
